major_runtime_result.interpretation: Chicken entities are runtime-generated by a population system. Direct player death is not required for creation, because increasing the target from 10 to 20 generated fresh chickens after the previous population had reached 0. However, automatic immediate refill after individual chicken deaths was not observed while the target remained unchanged.
